correctness.rationale: For any nondecreasing f, eventual 2-periodicity is fixed-point stabilization. The fibers of e=f² are rooted intervals invariant under f. On each side, a monotone square-zero collapse to the root is counted by C(a,2j), proved by choosing the terminal image t, positive support values and run multiplicities with Vandermonde summation. A sequence of k rooted blocks has weight (uvzL²)^k, and binomial extraction gives C(k+r−1,r−k)C(n+k−1,2r−1) with exact ranges and zero convention. Exhaustive direct monotone-map enumeration through n=10 and direct local-side checks through length 9 independently match all coefficients. Computation is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The previously studied exact semigroup family has natural Green J-rank (=image rank) and eventual-image rank statistics. Determining their entire joint distribution distinguishes idempotents and nonidempotent quasi-idempotents, gives all finite-rank strata and a rational parameter-generating function across all n, and resolves a concrete discrepancy in an existing finite count. This is a natural complete classification/enumeration, not a parameter-renaming or arbitrary finite slice. The known univariate sequence is explicitly not claimed as new.
